```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(fpp3)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4
)
source("lab_submission.R")

lab_meta <- list(id = "lab13", title = "Error Metrics")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "MAPE is problematic when:",
  q2 = "MASE compares MAE to which benchmark’s in-sample errors (by default idea)?",
  q3 = "Which metric would you report to a business partner, and why?"
)
```

## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Hold-out accuracy
```{r acc-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=10}
library(fpp3)
train <- aus_production |> filter_index(. ~ "2007 Q4")
fit <- train |> model(snaive = SNAIVE(Beer), ets = ETS(Beer))
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = 12)
fc |> accuracy(aus_production) |>
  select(.model, ME, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE)
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("Actuals are near zero (or zero)", correct = TRUE),
  answer("The series is seasonal"),
  answer("You used fpp3"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("A naïve / seasonal naïve scale", correct = TRUE),
  answer("AICc of ARIMA"),
  answer("The sample mean of MAPE"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "e.g. RMSE/MAE in megalitres because …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

Answer the questions above first, type your name, download the `.txt`, and upload it.

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
